The 2011 Ford F-350SD King Ranch combines capability with refined comfort. The powerful turbodiesel engine delivers the performance you need for demanding work and towing, while the TorqShift transmission ensures smooth, responsive power delivery. With 4WD, you'll have confidence navigating varied terrain and weather conditions.

Dual-zone front air conditioning keeps you comfortable regardless of the season, and the power moonroof adds an open-air dimension to your driving experience.

Technology integration is practical and straightforward. The navigation system with HD and satellite radio keeps you informed and entertained during long drives. Remote start capabilities allow you to warm up or cool down your truck before entering. The rear-view camera assists with backing and parking, while the overhead console organizes small items within arm's reach.

Safety and visibility receive the attention they deserve. Dual front airbags, side impact airbags, and the overhead airbag system work together with electronic stability control and traction control. ABS brakes provide dependable stopping power, and the rear-view camera enhances awareness when reversing.

The exterior features the King Ranch distinction with body-color mirror caps, painted grille with chrome insert, and 6-inch angular lighted running boards that add both function and style. PowerScope trailer-tow mirrors tilt and extend for improved visibility when towing, while the rear step bumper simplifies bed access.

This F-350SD represents a solid choice for those seeking a well-appointed diesel truck with the prestige of the King Ranch brand.
